REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
WEDNESDAY - JULY 1, 2026 - 07:00 P.M.
CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL CHAMBER
18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Community Development Department, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 2nd floor, Cerritos, CA, 90703 during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the Commission after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection at the Community Development Department during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to planning@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1201 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The Commission, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at cerritos.gov, on cable television at Cerritos TV3, or in person in the Council Chamber.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or or in writing as described below.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item. Public comment on Consent Calendar and non-agenda items will be opened and may be provided during Agenda Item No. 4.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to planning@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Community Development Department no later than 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 3:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the Commission prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact City of Cerritos ADA/504 Coordinator, Drew Schneider, at (562) 916-1314 at least 72 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Pledge of Allegiance
3.
Roll Call
4.
Public Comments and Suggestions
This section is reserved for public comment on Consent Calendar and items not listed on the agenda but that are within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Commission. Verbal comments may be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Chair extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes unless the Chair extends.
5.
Consent Calendar
Items listed under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the Commission, there will be no separate discussion of these items. If a Commission member requests separate consideration, the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
5A.
Approval of Minutes
Regular Meeting Minutes of June 3, 2026
6.
Public Hearings
6A.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 2026-6, A PROPOSAL BY DICK'S SPORTING GOODS, INC, FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF DICK'S HOUSE OF SPORT, A NEW RETAIL AND SPORTS EXPERIENCE STORE CONSISTING OF A 142,000-SQUARE-FOOT, TWO-STORY RETAIL BUILDING WITH ASSOCIATED LOADING AREAS AND AN 18,500-SQUARE-FOOT OUTDOOR ATHLETIC FIELD ON A 4.65-ACRE PROJECT SITE LOCATED AT 100 LOS CERRITOS MALL, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED AREA DEVELOPMENT PLAN TWENTY-ONE (ADP-21) (APN 7038-014-016). *

Exhibit 27-Presentation Packet
6B.
Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 1969-5(2026) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY THE PROPERTY OWNER TO REMODEL THE EXTERIOR OF THE EXISTING BUILDINGS AND COMPLETE OTHER RELATED SITE IMPROVEMENTS AT THE CARMENITA PLAZA NORTH SHOPPING CENTER LOCATED AT 13321 - 13349 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17303 CARMENITA ROAD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL (CN) (APNS 7008-015-002, 7008-015-003, AND 7008-015-004).*

Agenda Report

7.
Reports
7A.
Reports from Designated Commission Staff Liaison
During this part of the meeting, designated staff will have an opportunity to report on various City matters and/or respond verbally to questions or comments from the prior meeting, including any request by members to provide a brief supplemental report or brief follow-up response to items from the prior meeting agenda.
7B.
Reports from Planning Commission Members
During this part of the meeting, members may provide brief reports to the community on various matters of interest, including any mandated reports required by AB 1234. Pursuant to the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act and the City of Cerritos Commission and Committee Scope of Authority Policy, there may be no discussion or action taken on any matters presented during this item or that are not listed on the meeting agenda.
8.
Adjournment

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION
HELD WEDNESDAY, JULY 1, 2026, 7:00 PM, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBER AT
CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125 BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS CALIFORNIA.

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Commissioner Surti.

3.  Roll Call

  All Members of the Planning Commission were declared present except Commissioner
  Jhaveri, who was noted absent and excused by a majority consensus of the Planning
  Commission.

4.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Chair Ao invited comments and suggestions from the public on items not listed on
  the agenda.

  Cerritos resident David Pylman expressed support for the Planning Commission’s
  monthly meetings and referenced the Planning Commission’s discussion related to
  signs and scope of authority at the June 3, 2026 Planning Commission meeting.

  Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission, Chair
  Ao closed public comments.

5.  Consent Calendar

5A.  Approval of Minutes

  Wednesday, June 3, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission Regular Meeting Minutes.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Reyes, and seconded by Vice Chair
  Chauhan, to approve the Wednesday, June 3, 2026, 7:00 p.m. Planning Commission
  Regular Meeting Minutes.

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Jhaveri
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Public Hearings

6A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN
  2026-6, A PROPOSAL BY DICK'S SPORTING GOODS, INC, FOR THE CONSTRUCTION

City of Cerritos  July 1, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 1
   OF DICK'S HOUSE OF SPORT, A NEW RETAIL AND SPORTS EXPERIENCE STORE
  CONSISTING OF A 142,000-SQUARE-FOOT, TWO-STORY RETAIL BUILDING WITH
  ASSOCIATED LOADING AREAS AND AN 18,500-SQUARE-FOOT OUTDOOR ATHLETIC
  FIELD ON A 4.65-ACRE PROJECT SITE LOCATED AT 100 LOS CERRITOS MALL,
  CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED AREA DEVELOPMENT
  PLAN TWENTY-ONE (ADP-21) (APN 7038-014-016).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15332 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Current Planning Manager Amanda Acuña. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed providing details about the proposed redevelopment,
  which includes the construction of a new 141,630 square-foot two-story retail and
  sports experience store, with associated loading areas and an ancillary 18,515-
  square-foot outdoor athletic field that will serve as an accessory experiential sports
  component of the retail use. Mrs. Acuña concluded her presentation by stating that
  the project applicant and architect are available to answer any questions the
  Commission may have.

  Discussion followed regarding a public comment letter submitted by Supporters
  Alliance for Environmental Responsibility, or SAFER, concerning the use of a Class 32
  Categorical Exemption under CEQA for the proposed project. Additional discussion
  addressed the proposed locations of Dick's House of Sport business signage, parking
  availability and whether dedicated parking would be provided, nearby freeway
  access, and the store's amenities, including the indoor rock climbing feature.

  Assistant City Attorney Shukan Patel discussed the comment letter received by
  SAFER, explaining that the proposed development is being evaluated as part of the
  overall project, including the demolition of the existing building, and that the City's
  environmental consultant had previously conducted an extensive analysis supporting
  the applicability of the Class 32 Categorical Exemption.

  Chair Ao opened the public hearing. The applicant's representative, Brian Bacik,
  provided additional information regarding Dick's House of Sport, including the
  company's operations, comparable locations throughout the country, and various
  store features, such as the indoor rock climbing wall and other experiential
  amenities.

  Additional discussion ensued regarding anticipated customer foot traffic, the
  estimated number of employees, the hiring process, the reasons for selecting
  Cerritos as the project location, the project's potential economic benefits and tax
  revenue, opportunities associated with the upcoming Olympic Games, and
  surrounding transportation infrastructure, including freeway access and traffic
  circulation.

  Seeing and hearing no speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission, Chair
  Ao closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Commissioner Reyes and seconded by Vice Chair
  Chauhan to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-18: Review and
  consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS
  PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 2026-6, A
  PROPOSAL BY DICK'S SPORTING GOODS, INC, FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF DICK'S

City of Cerritos  July 1, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 2
   HOUSE OF SPORT, A NEW RETAIL AND SPORTS EXPERIENCE STORE CONSISTING
  OF A 142,000-SQUARE-FOOT, TWO-STORY RETAIL BUILDING WITH ASSOCIATED
  LOADING AREAS AND AN 18,500-SQUARE-FOOT OUTDOOR ATHLETIC FIELD ON A
  4.65-ACRE PROJECT SITE LOCATED AT 100 LOS CERRITOS MALL, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA 90703. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED AREA DEVELOPMENT PLAN
  TWENTY-ONE (ADP-21) (APN 7038-014-016).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15332 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Jhaveri
  ABSTAIN:  None

6B.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN
  1969-5(2026) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY THE PROPERTY OWNER TO REMODEL
  THE EXTERIOR OF THE EXISTING BUILDINGS AND COMPLETE OTHER RELATED SITE
  IMPROVEMENTS AT THE CARMENITA PLAZA NORTH SHOPPING CENTER LOCATED AT
  13321 – 13349 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17303 CARMENITA ROAD, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA 90703. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL
  (CN) (APNS 7008-015-002, 7008-015-003, AND 7008-015-004).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Senior Planner Jeremy Loh. A PowerPoint presentation
  was displayed, providing details about the proposed exterior remodel of the existing
  buildings and other related site improvements within the shopping center located at
  13321-13349 Artesia Boulevard and 17303 Carmenita Road, Cerritos, California,
  90703. Mr. Loh continued his concluded his presentation by stating that the project
  applicants are available to answer any questions the Commission may have.
  Discussion followed regarding the existing legal nonconformity related to the number
  of parking spaces at the shopping center. Additional discussion addressed parking
  stall dimensions, business signage, the existing and proposed monument signage
  along the street frontages, and the potential for future remodeling of adjacent
  portions of the shopping center.

  Chair Ao opened the public hearing. The project applicant, Vasken Tatarian, provided
  additional information regarding the proposed project, including the existing tenants
  within the shopping center, whether tenant businesses would remain operational
  during construction, and the existing perimeter wall adjacent to the neighboring
  school.

  Cerritos resident David Pylman and commercial property owner Samir Ram provided
  public comments regarding the project's proximity to the neighboring school, parking
  availability, and opportunities to coordinate future improvements with neighboring
  businesses and encourage additional façade renovations within the shopping center.

City of Cerritos  July 1, 2026
Planning Commission Meeting Minutes  Page 3
   Seeing and hearing no other speakers wishing to address the Planning Commission,
  Chair Ao closed the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Vice Chair Chauhan and seconded by Commissioner
  Reyes to waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2026-19: Review and
  consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CERRITOS
  PLANNING COMMISSION RECOMMENDING APPROVAL OF PRECISE PLAN 1969-
  5(2026) AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY THE PROPERTY OWNER TO REMODEL THE
  EXTERIOR OF THE EXISTING BUILDINGS AND COMPLETE OTHER RELATED SITE
  IMPROVEMENTS AT THE CARMENITA PLAZA NORTH SHOPPING CENTER LOCATED AT
  13321 – 13349 ARTESIA BOULEVARD AND 17303 CARMENITA ROAD, CERRITOS,
  CALIFORNIA 90703. THE SUBJECT SITE IS ZONED NEIGHBORHOOD COMMERCIAL
  (CN) (APNS 7008-015-002, 7008-015-003, AND 7008-015-004).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  Guidelines, this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  The motion carried (4-0) as follows:

  AYES:  Ao, Chauhan, Surti, Reyes
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Jhaveri
  ABSTAIN:  None

7.  Reports

7A.  Reports from Designated Commission Liaison

  A report was provided by Designated Commission Liaison Amanda Acuña providing
  follow-up to the Commission's request made at the June 3, 2026, meeting. Staff
  provided the Commission with the City’s Guidebook for Elected and Appointed
  Officials prepared by the Office of the City Clerk, as well as information outlining the
  policy and process for the Planning Commission to bring forward requests for policy
  changes.

7B.  Reports from Planning Commission Members
  Reports were given by Vice Chair Chauhan and Chair Ao.

8.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 8:44 p.m.

  /s/ Amanda Acuña
  Amanda Acuña
  Secretary to the Planning Commission

 Attest:
